mechanism: Sulfasalazine may reduce progesterone efficacy through enterohepatic circulation inhibition and potential CYP3A4 enzyme induction, particularly affecting oral contraceptive efficacy when progesterone is used for contraception.
action: Monitor contraceptive efficacy if progesterone-containing oral contraceptives are used; consider alternative or backup contraception during sulfasalazine therapy and for 7 days after discontinuation.
